name: Touketsu no Digital Joshi ■ Gakusei to Koumon Onanii Live Chat!
original_name: 凍結のデジタル 女子■学生と肛門オナニーLiveChat!
source:
A fresh roll-play software to chat with a school girl.

You enjoy the voice chat with a girl you met on the net during the night.
However your parents won't understand you. You need to turn off your PC if you notice their footsteps approaching (by hitting it).

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE142988.html]DLsite English[/url]]
